notes: PROPOSED District 2 concept & blockout v1 (Unit AR). No data/buildings-district2.json exists yet: plots reference zone + tier + proposed_use only, never building ids (building_id is null on every plot). All geometry is PROPOSED until the owner confirms or revises it; a revision is a data edit, not a redesign (same rule as GDD-04's proposed level names). District 2 sits immediately north of District 1 in the same Rupsha City coordinate frame and World Partition map (TECH-MULTIDISTRICT §3.1, §3.5); its south edge (z -500) is District 1's north edge, joined at d2_j_south_gate (0,-500) where d2_seg_civic_ave_s meets District 1's seg_civic_ave_n.

phase8_first_slice.name: Phase 8 first slice (PROPOSED)
phase8_first_slice.notes: The subset the owner would build FIRST if District 2 is confirmed: a 400 m x 400 m box around the Northgate crossing (0,-1080), mirroring District 1's Phase 1 test scene (TECH-DISTRICT1-BLOCKOUT §6) — one arterial crossing, the North Bazar spine head, the garden lanes and the North Green park edge. It is a subset, not a separate map: same ids, same coordinates. District 2 is Phase 8 work (TECH-MULTIDISTRICT); nothing here is a Phase 1 commitment.

bridge.status: No bridge in District 2. The only crossing remains District 1's Rupsha Bridge approach (seg_bridge_approach), a Phase 8 travel gate (GDD-02 §4; TECH-MULTIDISTRICT §3.5). No second bridge is proposed.

river.name: Rupsha River
river.notes: Cited from District 1 (data/district1-blockout.json river band): the river does not enter District 2. The band lies approx 932 m south of District 2's south edge (z -500), across the whole of District 1; District 2 has no riverfront zone, no ghat and no river geometry. Riverfront anchors close under storm (GDD-06 §7) — that rule applies in District 1 only.

road_segments.name: Civic Ave North (District 2, south)
road_segments.notes: Joins District 1 at d2_j_south_gate (0,-500), where District 1's seg_civic_ave_n ends (TECH-MULTIDISTRICT §3.2: new segments join the existing graph at a named junction).

road_segments.name: North Bazar Spine
road_segments.pedestrian_priority: 07:00-22:00 bollards up; delivery vehicles only before 07:00 (GDD-02 §3, as District 1 Market Spine)

road_segments.name: Maidan Promenade
road_segments.notes: PROPOSED extension of the promenade class (GDD-02 §3) from a riverfront to a maidan edge: pedestrian + cycles, no vehicles.
